item.title: Double your donation in December
item.description: The Prison Radio Association is taking part in the 2025 Big Give Christmas Challenge to raise vital funds for our work with women in HMP Styal. For seven days, between Tuesday 2nd December and Tuesday 9th December, anything you give to this campaign will be doubled. item.description: This year, we launched our biggest ever public fundraising campaign, to raise vital funds for our work with women housed at HMP Styal. item.title: Farewell, Phil Maguire
item.description: After nearly two decades of energy, passion and deeply human leadership, our founding Chief Executive, Phil Maguire, will step down at the end of this year.
